(NYSE:NOW) — ServiceNow joined Anthropic’s $13 billion Series F in September 2025 and followed up with a January 2026 partnership embedding Claude into its workflow-automation platform for enterprise customers.
None of these are pure plays — Anthropic exposure sits diluted inside the larger businesses with valuations marked to private funding rounds rather than a public market.

Anthropic’s own executives have not confirmed a listing valuation, even as its confidential S-1 moves through SEC review. But for investors unwilling to wait on the sidelines, these eight tickers already have skin in the game.
